logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the round-1 C assurance handover on WO-01 pump module selection. Left panel: a correctly scaled bar chart of measured energy per common acceptance run — P2 12 kWh (highlighted as winner; quality 97, 1 defect), P3 52 (quality 80, 3 defects), P1 56 (quality 84, 4 defects), P4 58 (quality 81, 0 defects) — on a single baseline so the 40 kWh gap to runner-up P3 is visible. Right panel: the round-1 reconciliation chain: A's proposal brief (prose correct, but chart bars off-scale, P1 labels on the P4 bar, blank second subfigure, truncated recommendation) flowing to B's verification memo (arithmetic reconciles with the trusted table and P2 is confirmed, but A's figure errors were missed and B's own chart is off-scale), then to C's assurance handover (decision reconciled; six open questions recorded), and onward to the next analyst's instruction to recompute from the trusted table and verify figure-to-value correspondence before endorsing any chart. Palette: dark navy headings, one blue winner bar, light blue other bars, pale blue rounded boxes with blue arrows on white. All text serves the client analysis; no decorative or hidden elements.
